conf.description: SOAR console audit trail, api-pull: normalizes Cortex XSOAR /settings/audits and Splunk SOAR /rest/audit records (two different vendor column shapes) onto one schema, routes Action Run/Playbook Run rows out to the action-execution dataset, caps OLD/NEW VALUE with truncation flags.

conf.comment: xsoar-soar/console-audit/api-pull. No Elastic integration or Cribl Pack exists for either vendor's management-audit API. Normalizes XSOAR (modified/user/type/object/identifier/action/id/version/NOTE) and Splunk SOAR (USER, USER ID, OBJECT TYPE, CHANGED FIELD, OLD VALUE, NEW VALUE, AUDIT SOURCE, IP ADDRESS, RELATED OBJECT TYPE/ID) column shapes onto one soar.audit.* + ECS schema. AUDIT SOURCE=Action Run/Playbook Run rows are dropped here per recommendations.direct.cribl - they belong to the action-execution dataset's own pipeline.
